set-variable.name: throttleState
set-variable.value: @{ JObject loaded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("throttleState", null); JObject map = (loaded != null && loaded["backends"] != null && loaded["backends"].Type == JTokenType.Object) ? (JObject)loaded["backends"] : new JObject(); JObject wrapper = new JObject( new JProperty("dirty", false), new JProperty("backends", map) ); JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"]; int idx = (int)context.Variables["backendIndex"]; if (idx < 0 || idx >= backends.Count) { return wrapper; } JObject backend = (JObject)backends[idx]; string id = backend.Value<string>("affinity"); /* Retry-after from the response header, else the backend default */ int retryAfterSeconds = backend["defaultRetryAfter"].Value<int>(); foreach (string headerName in new[] { "retry-after" }) { if (context.Response.Headers.Keys.Any(k => string.Equals(k, headerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))) { string headerValue = context.Response.Headers[headerName].FirstOrDefault(); if (int.TryParse(headerValue, out int parsedValue) && parsedValue > 0) { retryAfterSeconds = parsedValue + 2; break; } } } /* Multi-process safe: keep the max wake time for this backend id */ DateTime newWake = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(retryAfterSeconds); DateTime existing = (map[id] != null && map[id].Type != JTokenType.Null) ? map[id].Value<DateTime>() : DateTime.MinValue; if (newWake > existing) { map[id] = newWake; wrapper["dirty"] = true; } DateTime effective = map[id].Value<DateTime>(); backend["isThrottling"] = true; backend["retryAfter"] = effective; var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("activityLog", new JArray()); var remainingSeconds = effective > DateTime.UtcNow ? (int)Math.Ceiling((effective - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalSeconds) : 0; var retryAfterText = string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", remainingSeconds / 60, remainingSeconds % 60); var statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode.ToString() ?? "N/A"; arr.Add(new JObject { { "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") }, { "message", "StatusCode: " + statusCode + " - Temp Error; THROTTLED: " + backend.Value<string>("label") + " Retry-After: " + retryAfterText } }); return wrapper; }

set-variable.name: unThrottledBackends
set-variable.value: @{ var backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("listBackends", new JArray()); var priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"]; bool contextWindowExceeded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("contextWindowExceeded", false); int count=0; foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) { JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i]; /* Skip PTU backends if context window exceeded */ if (contextWindowExceeded && backend.Value<string>("label") == "PTU") { continue; } if (!backend.Value<bool>("isThrottling")) { count++; } } return count; }

set-variable.name: RetryRemaining
set-variable.value: @{ var isPermError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("isPermError", false); var retryCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("RetryCount", -1); var unthrottled = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("unThrottledBackends", 0); var RequeueAllowed = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("RequeueAllowed", true); var proxyWillRequeue = RequeueAllowed && (unthrottled == 0); /* retryCount has already been decremented for the attempt just made. */ return (!isPermError && retryCount > 0) && !proxyWillRequeue; }

set-variable.name: Return429
set-variable.value: @{ var isPermError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("isPermError", false); var RetryRemaining = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("RetryRemaining", true); var RequeueAllowed = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("RequeueAllowed", true); var unthrottled = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("unThrottledBackends", 0); return !isPermError && unthrottled == 0 && (RequeueAllowed || !RetryRemaining); }

set-variable.name: activityLog
set-variable.value: @{ /* Retry Decision */ var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("activityLog", new JArray()); if (!context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("Return429", false)) { return arr; } var backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("listBackends", new JArray()); var priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"]; var now = DateTime.UtcNow; var parts = new List<string>(priorityBackendIndxs.Count); foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) { if (i < 0 || i >= backends.Count) { continue; } JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i]; string label = backend.Value<string>("label"); if (!backend.Value<bool>("isThrottling")) { parts.Add(label + " ready"); continue; } DateTime retryAfter = backend.Value<DateTime>("retryAfter"); int secs = retryAfter > now ? (int)Math.Ceiling((retryAfter - now).TotalSeconds) : 0; parts.Add(label + " " + string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", secs / 60, secs % 60)); } arr.Add(new JObject { { "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") }, { "message", "REQUEUE: " + string.Join(", ", parts) } }); return arr; }

set-variable.name: sleepDuration
set-variable.value: @{ JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("listBackends", new JArray()); JArray priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"]; DateTime minRetryTime = DateTime.MaxValue; foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) { if (backends[i].Value<bool>("isThrottling") && backends[i].Value<DateTime>("retryAfter") < minRetryTime) { minRetryTime = backends[i].Value<DateTime>("retryAfter"); } } if (minRetryTime > DateTime.UtcNow) { return (int)Math.Min(120000, (minRetryTime - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalMilliseconds); } return 1000; }
